entities.name: Béla of Macsó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Béla of Macsó was a member of the Olgovichi clan. He was Duke of Macsó (1262–1272) and of Bosnia (1266/1271–1272); and thus he governed the southern provinces of the Kingdom of Hungary.
